text:
Jamie Benn has 999 career points, all of them for Dallas, and the next one makes the 37-year-old captain a fifth-round pick turned 1,000-point player. Blackout Dallas has already started the legacy debate. The 2015 Art Ross winner is 1,269 games into a one-team career.

He is a different player now, playing under 13 minutes a night in a depth role with seven points in 17 games. But the minutes are good ones. Dallas has 55% of shot attempts and 56% of expected goals with him on the ice at 5v5, almost seven points better than without him. His three goals sit close to 2.29 expected, so nothing about his scoring looks lucky.

Evolving-Hockey had him worth 0.6 wins above replacement last season, with his offense held back by penalties (he takes more than he draws). Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking still had him taking a healthy share of shots off passes across the slot. He finds the dangerous ice.

He made a Yahoo Sports list of the league's most disliked players this month, which he has probably heard before. One point to go.
headline: Jamie Benn sits one point from 1,000
